# SQLite (winsqlite3.dll)

| | |
|---|---|
| Component | SQLite, as shipped with Windows (`winsqlite3.dll`) |
| Used for | Report index (`data\reports.db`) and duplicate hash cache (`data\cache\hashes.db`); reading/cleaning Firefox `places.sqlite` (opt-in rule) |
| Distribution | **Not shipped with CLEANit.** CLEANit calls the copy that is part of Windows 10/11 and Windows Server 2016+. |
| License | Public Domain |
| Website | https://sqlite.org |
